column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN batch-grader STEP TABLE: THE GRADER MOVES INTO SCRIP -- ONE PROCESS RUNS A LIST OF PROGRAMS AND RESETS ITS BASE MEMORY CLEANLY BETWEEN THEM (the cio, 2026-11-05, on Lon's word in the cio's window 14:5x CST: "For the test harness, you should move INTO SCRIP. Let scrip run a list of source files on the command line, and reset its base memory cleanly each time. Maybe with a new MMAP and memset clear etc. Should that not run blazingly fast?"; the design text in .github/skills/suites-and-grading/SKILL.md section 5; the SCRIP side RULED by the cto: CTO-515, amended by CTO-522 2026-11-05 17:3x: the switch is --harness (Lon's spelling), the reset between rows is a FORK from a warm parent (the kernel restores the image by copy-on-write; the parent wait4s each child with the row's timeout_s as its deadline and writes the record from the status and rusage), no handler set, no siglongjmp, no rt_exit; the record's fifth column is maxrss_kb; steps 8 and 9 added for the Prolog prelude).

# harness/scripts/test_design_batch_grader_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE, one bash command from S4E_HOME over the witnesses in this folder (each .sno beside a .ref cut from sbl -bf, the .icn beside a .ref cut from icont/iconx; bg07's .in is its stdin; bg08's .expect is the batch record kind the oracle cannot answer, a hang); --cut re-cuts every ref.

# THE LIST FILE a probe writes (the --harness argument, one row per program, tab-separated). THE KEYED ROW (CTO-554 step 10a; the design text is skill suites-and-grading reference section 5): attribute fields name= stdin= stdout= stderr= (a path or merged) cwd= env=NAME=VALUE (repeatable) timeout_s=, in any order before the source; a field starting with - before the source is a scrip switch of that row (the sizes as -dNk -sNk, --dialect=unicon, any switch the driver takes for one program); the first other field is the source; every field after it is the program's argv. Defaults: name the source's basename without its extension, stdin /dev/null, stdout and stderr inherited (under --out DIR: DIR/NAME.out and DIR/NAME.err), cwd the harness's, timeout_s 60; every path of a row is read from its cwd. SINCE 10a (CTO-554) the probes of 1 2 3 4 6 8 8b 8c 9d write keyed rows (name= stdin= stdout= stderr= timeout_s= -dNk -sNk SOURCE); the positional form is gone. THE RECORD scrip writes (--record FILE, or stderr when no --record; one row per program, in list order): name rc kind secs maxrss_kb, kind one of RAN HANG CRASH REFUSED, maxrss_kb the row's ru_maxrss from wait4 in KB (0 on every row: nothing the row did survives the reset).

# probe tokens: none; each probe is the whole measurement (rc 0 GREEN, 1 RED, 2 could not measure), and a step whose instrument does not exist yet reads RED, never REFUSED, because the probe asks scrip for the switch and scrip's refusal is the red.

# CTO-550 (the cto, 2026-11-08): steps 8 and 9 cut under THE HAIKU BAR into 8a 8b 8c (mode 3, the warm parent) and 9a 9b 9c 9d 9e (mode 4, the two-unit shape); 8 and 9 stay the acceptance probes; the design text is skill prolog-engine reference.md section 6; witnesses bg12 (a program redefines the base-prelude predicate last/2), bg13 (a program imports library(assoc)), bg14 (an unknown procedure's error term) cut from swipl -q -t halt. CTO-551 (the cto, 2026-11-08 08:4x CST, on officer_04's ask): the mode-4 road is the mode-3 road's two compiles in one process (the warm compile under harness_warm 1 writes the prelude unit, the program compile under harness_warm 2 the program unit; the sink is the compile, not the origin field); 9a depends on 8c; 9a and 9b link and do not run; 9c runs the five witnesses and bg13 under stress; the design text is section 6 as amended.
